# Catalogue

`Service: svc-catalogue` `LIVE`

## What it does

Carries the value the descriptor meant to state, spelled as an enum value is spelled. The
range refuses it, so the record's own `enum` finding stands beside the descriptor's.

## Where it lives

The `catalogue` repository.
